articles.title: Live Coverage: SpaceX Falcon 9 to launch Starlink satellites from West Coast
articles.summary: Liftoff from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California is scheduled for 8:51 a.m. PDT (11:51 a.m. EDT / 1551 UTC). The Falcon 9 will place 24 Starlink satellites into orbit.

articles.title: Super Heavy-Starship rocket chalks up mostly successful test flight
articles.summary: Powered by 33 methane-fueled Raptor engines, the 397-foot-tall two-stage rocket blasted off from SpaceX's "Starbase," Texas, launch site at 5:51 p.m. EDT, putting on a spectacular show for area residents and tourists as it climbed away atop some 16 million pounds of thrust.

articles.title: SpaceX conducts 13th Starship test flight
articles.summary:
SpaceX launched Starship on its 13th suborbital test flight July 24, correcting some of the issues seen on the previous flight while deploying functioning satellites for the first time.
